content:
UPSSSC Vidhan Bhawan Guard / Fireman syllabus covers general subjects and physical standards as applicable for security / fire posts.

Written exam areas (typical)

  • General Knowledge / Current Affairs
  • General Hindi
  • Elementary Mathematics
  • Reasoning
  • Basic awareness related to fire safety / security (if in syllabus)

Also prepare for PET/PST if prescribed in the advertisement.
